name: @omadia/channel-api
description: Public API channel for the byte5 Harness (issue #438). Exposes chat (and later other flows) over a documented HTTP API at /api/public/v1, authenticated by per-key vault-backed API keys instead of an operator session cookie. kind: channel; drives turns via CoreApi.handleTurnStream so responses go through the same orchestrator + privacy-guard pipeline every other channel uses.
